abstract: Thirty patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer and no evidence of metastases outside the retroperitoneum were evaluated for discrepancy between the clinical and pathologic stages and also for frequency of elevations of the serum levels of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and alphafetoprotein (AFP). When marker-level data were not considered in the staging, the clinical and pathologic stages differed in 47% of the patients; the inclusion of marker data reduced the staging error to 37%. Seven of ten patients with clinical Stage I, pathologic Stage II disease had normal marker levels (false-negative results). However, there were no false-positive results: abnormal marker levels before retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy always signalled persistent tumor unless the level could be accounted for by the metabolic decay rate of marker produced by the primary tumor. Comparison of marker-level data from these patients with data from 48 patients with Stage III disease demonstrated increasing frequency of elevated marker levels with increasing stage (P less than 0.001). Serial determinations of HCG and AFP are helpful in clinical staging and are necessary in clinical management.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜に限局し遠隔転移のない非セミノーマ精巣がん30例を対象に、臨床病期と病理病期の不一致、ならびにヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の血清値上昇の頻度を評価した。腫瘍マーカーのデータを病期分類に考慮しない場合、臨床病期と病理病期は患者の47%で異なっていた。マーカーのデータを含めると、病期分類の誤差は37%に減少した。臨床病期I・病理病期IIの患者10例中7例はマーカー値が正常であった(偽陰性)。しかし偽陽性の結果はなかった。リンパ節郭清前に上昇したマーカー値は、原発腫瘍が産生したマーカーの代謝減衰速度で説明できない限り、必ず遺残腫瘍を示していた。病期III患者48例のデータと比較すると、病期の進行に伴いマーカー上昇の頻度が増加した(P<0.001)。hCGおよびAFPの連続測定は臨床病期分類に有用であり、臨床管理に必要である。
